etymologies.etymologyHTML: From dis- +‎ able.

definitions.definition: (transitive) To render unable; to take away an ability of, as by crippling.
(chiefly of a person) To impair the physical or mental abilities of; to cause a serious, permanent injury.

quote.citation: 2013, Steven McLaughlin, Clubland UK: On the Door in the Rave Era:
quote.text: Krav is a martial art of last resort that assumes no quarter and focuses purely on disarming, disabling and, if necessary, destroying your opponent.

quote.citation: 2016, Justin O. Schmidt, The Sting of the Wild, Johns Hopkins University Press, →ISBN, page 102:
quote.text: Fire ants circumvented the problem of an ineffective sting by having an unusual and highly effective venom that when daubed or sprayed on other ants penetrates their waxy protective integumental barrier and kills or disables them.

definitions.definition: (chiefly electronics, computing) To deactivate, to make inoperational (especially of a function of an electronic or mechanical device).
